title: Document timeZone for floating recurrence-id override filtering
description: c35373b (#448): CalendarEvent/get timeZone also translates floating events' recurrence ids for recurrenceOverridesBefore/After. Handler already forwards time_zone (event.rs:157-161) but CalendarEventGetArgs.time_zone doc (backend.rs:1415-1424) says no effect without utcStart/utcEnd; get_calendar_events doc (backend.rs:803-815) silent. Fix docs, add test that time_zone is forwarded when only override bounds are given.
close_reason: Documented that timeZone also translates override recurrence ids (-34). main: 065a9dde
